window.note: First edition: KEV additions dated since the previous calendar day.

executive.summary: CISA added 4 vulnerabilities to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog since the previous edition, affecting Apache, Broadcom, Cisco. 4 meet the emergency criteria (confirmed exploitation plus critical severity or unauthenticated network exposure).
developments: CVE-2026-129448 — Apache Roller: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability (emergency)
CVE-2026-123890 — Broadcom VMware vCenter: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability (emergency)
CVE-2026-76466 — Cisco Expressway Series: Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability (emergency)

actions.title: Patch or mitigate Apache Roller (CVE-2026-129448)
actions.why: Exploitation confirmed by CISA KEV; CVSS 3.1 9.8; network-reachable without authentication.
steps: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
Identify internet-facing and internal Apache Roller instances.
Confirm fixed versions in the vendor advisory before closing the action.
CISA due date for federal agencies: 2026-11-23.

cves.name: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
cves.description: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.

cves.name: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
cves.description: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

cves.name: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
cves.description: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.
